theorems.name: Submission.aal_packing_finite_net
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (S E : Set X) (r a b : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < a → 0 ≤ b → μ E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b → (∀ y ∈ S, closedBall y r ⊆ E ∧ ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ μ (closedBall y r)) → ∃ F : Finset X, (↑F : Set X) ⊆ S ∧ (F.card : ℝ) * a ≤ b ∧ ∀ y ∈ S, ∃ z ∈ F, dist y z ≤ 2 * r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
